route_title: Periodic 12-layer stack for layer-count scaling study
compilation_rationale: Compiled as a 12-period alternating chalcogenide stack optimized for a broad LWIR passband and suppressed MWIR response. Spectral sweep covers both bands. Uniform initial quarter-wave bounds applied to each finite layer. Coherent TMM with s-matrix solver selected. Soft ranking targets enforce band-selective transmittance.
